"'''Lys and the Snowy Mountain Rescue / Attack of the Training Droids'''" is the fourth episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season One|first season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney+]] on [[May 4]], [[2023]].<ref name="D23 May" />

==Official description==
''The Jedi herd creatures. The kids must stop droids.''
